name: Nissan Silvia Spec-R (S15, 1999)
chassisNote: Light RWD coupe archetype; factory turbo lives in the engine, not the chassis key. Shortlist keeps NA Sports next to other light RWD icons.

gearset.src: Nissan Japan Silvia press kit 19 Jan 1999 (spec-R 6MT column): 3.626/2.200/1.541/1.213/1.000/0.767, final 3.692.

enginePreset.name: Nissan SR20DET (Silvia Spec-R S15)
enginePreset.note: Nissan press kit: 250 PS @ 6400, 28.0 kg·m (= 275 Nm) @ 4800, bore×stroke 86×86, CR 8.5. Peak boost ~0.8–0.9 bar typical for late S15 ball-bearing turbo (unsure). hp stored as brochure 250 PS number (batch-1 convention).

sources.engine: https://global.nissannews.com/en/releases/19990119-e_presskit — SR20DET 250 PS / 28.0 kg·m, 86.0×86.0, CR 8.5, curb 1240 kg, dims, 6MT ratios.
sources.body: Nissan Silvia press kit 1999: 4445×1695×1285 mm, wb 2525, tracks 1470/1460, curb 1240 kg (spec-R 6MT). Cd 0.30 from secondary compilations (listed unsure).
sources.performance: Period / secondary 0–100 ~5.5 s; JDM top often quoted at the 180 km/h limiter (unsure). Unlimited cars are faster.
sources.fit: Nissan press kit: 205/55R16, ventilated front discs with opposed 4-piston calipers on Spec-R, helical LSD on MT.

note: Factory turbo; shortlist category stays NA Sports (may move to Turbo Performance at import). Curb 1240 kg is Nissan's published Spec-R 6MT figure (fluids, no driver — JDM curb). Frontal area = 1.695 × 1.285 × 0.81 ≈ 1.76 m². fWt 0.55 layout estimate. Torque 28.0 kg·m × 9.80665 ≈ 275 Nm. Rotor ~280 mm common Spec-R figure (unsure). Optional HICAS not modelled.
